title: त्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 130 · The fords of the Yamuna and the hawk and dove

summary.en: Lomasha shows more holy places along the Yamuna and the Sarasvati where men reach heaven by austerity, and begins the story of King Ushinara, to whose thigh a dove fled for refuge from a hawk.
summary.kn: ತಪಸ್ಸಿನಿಂದ ಮನುಷ್ಯರು ಸ್ವರ್ಗ ಸೇರುವ ಯಮುನೆ ಸರಸ್ವತಿಗಳ ತೀರದ ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ಪುಣ್ಯಸ್ಥಳಗಳನ್ನು ಲೋಮಶರು ತೋರಿಸಿ, ಗಿಡುಗನಿಂದ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಪಾರಿವಾಳವು ತೊಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಶ್ರಯ ಪಡೆದ ಉಶೀನರರಾಜನ ಕಥೆ ಆರಂಭಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: लोमश यमुना और सरस्वती के किनारे और पवित्र स्थान दिखाते हैं जहाँ मनुष्य तप से स्वर्ग पाते हैं, और राजा उशीनर की कथा आरम्भ करते हैं, जिनकी जाँघ पर बाज़ से बचने के लिए एक कबूतर ने शरण ली।
summary.te: తపస్సుతో మనుషులు స్వర్గం చేరే యమునా సరస్వతీ తీరాల మరిన్ని పుణ్యస్థలాలను లోమశుడు చూపించి, డేగ నుండి తప్పించుకోవడానికి పావురం తొడపై శరణు పొందిన ఉశీనరరాజు కథ ప్రారంభిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: தவத்தால் மனிதர் ஸ்வர்க்கம் அடையும் யமுனை, ஸரஸ்வதிக் கரையிலுள்ள மேலும் பல புனிதத் தலங்களை லோமஶர் காட்டி, பருந்திடமிருந்து தப்ப ஒரு புறா தொடையில் அடைக்கலம் புகுந்த உஶீனர மன்னனின் கதையைத் தொடங்குகிறார்.
summary.ml: യമുനയുടെയും സരസ്വതിയുടെയും തീരങ്ങളിലെ മറ്റ് പുണ്യസ്ഥലങ്ങൾ ലോമശൻ കാണിക്കുന്നു; തപസ്സിലൂടെ മനുഷ്യർ സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലെത്തുന്ന ഇടങ്ങളാണവ. അദ്ദേഹം ഉശീനരരാജാവിന്റെ കഥ തുടങ്ങുന്നു: പരുന്തിൽനിന്ന് രക്ഷതേടി ഒരു പ്രാവ് അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ തുടയിൽ അഭയം തേടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.130; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: लोमश उवाच

meaning.en: Lomasha said:

verses.text:
इह मर्त्यास्तपस्तप्त्वा स्वर्गं गच्छन्ति भारत ।
मर्तुकामा नरा राजन्निहायान्ति सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Bharata, mortals who practise austerity here go to heaven. King, men who wish to die come here in their thousands.

verses.text:
एवमाशीः प्रयुक्ता हि दक्षेण यजता पुरा ।
इह ये वै मरिष्यन्ति ते वै स्वर्गजितो नराः ॥

meaning.en: For this was the blessing pronounced long ago by Daksha when he sacrificed: "Those who die here will be men who have won heaven."

verses.text:
एषा सरस्वती पुण्या दिव्या चोघवती नदी ।
एतद्विनशनं नाम सरस्वत्या विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: This is the holy, divine, swift-flowing river Sarasvati. This place, lord of the people, is called Vinashana, where Sarasvati vanishes.

verses.text:
द्वारं निषादराष्ट्रस्य येषां द्वेषात्सरस्वती ।
प्रविष्टा पृथिवीं वीर मा निषादा हि मां विदुः ॥

meaning.en: This is the gate of the Nishada country. Out of hatred for them Sarasvati went into the earth, saying, "Let the Nishadas not know me."

verses.text:
एष वै चमसोद्भेदो यत्र दृश्या सरस्वती ।
यत्रैनामभ्यवर्तन्त दिव्याः पुण्याः समुद्रगाः ॥

meaning.en: This is Chamasodbheda, where the Sarasvati is seen again, where the divine, holy rivers that flow to the ocean came to meet her.

verses.text:
एतत्सिन्धोर्महत्तीर्थं यत्रागस्त्यमरिंदम ।
लोपामुद्रा समागम्य भर्तारमवृणीत वै ॥

meaning.en: Destroyer of foes, this is the great ford of the Sindhu, where Lopamudra met Agastya and chose him as husband.

verses.text:
एतत्प्रभासते तीर्थं प्रभासं भास्करद्युते ।
इन्द्रस्य दयितं पुण्यं पवित्रं पापनाशनम् ॥

meaning.en: Brilliant as the sun, this ford shines: Prabhasa, dear to Indra, holy, purifying and a destroyer of sins.

verses.text:
एतद्विष्णुपदं नाम दृश्यते तीर्थमुत्तमम् ।
एषा रम्या विपाशा च नदी परमपावनी ॥

meaning.en: This excellent ford called Vishnupada is seen, and here is the lovely river Vipasha, supremely purifying.

verses.text:
अत्रैव पुत्रशोकेन वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः ।
बद्ध्वात्मानं निपतितो विपाशः पुनरुत्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Right here the holy seer Vasishtha, in grief for his sons, bound himself and fell in, and rose again free of his bonds, whence the name Vipasha.

verses.text:
काश्मीरमण्डलं चैतत्सर्वपुण्यमरिंदम ।
महर्षिभिश्चाध्युषितं पश्येदं भ्रातृभिः सह ॥

meaning.en: And this is the region of Kashmir, entirely sacred, destroyer of foes, inhabited by great seers. Look at it with your brothers.

verses.text:
अत्रोत्तराणां सर्वेषामृषीणां नाहुषस्य च ।
अग्नेश्चात्रैव संवादः काश्यपस्य च भारत ॥

meaning.en: Here took place the conversation of all the northern seers with Nahusha's son, and with Agni and Kashyapa, Bharata.

verses.text:
एतद्द्वारं महाराज मानसस्य प्रकाशते ।
वर्षमस्य गिरेर्मध्ये रामेण श्रीमता कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Great king, this shines forth as the gateway to Manasa. Here the glorious Rama made a rain in the middle of the mountain.

verses.text:
एष वातिकषण्डो वै प्रख्यातः सत्यविक्रमः ।
नाभ्यवर्तत यद्द्वारं विदेहानुत्तरं च यः ॥

meaning.en: This is the famed Vatikashanda of true valour, which the gateway to Videha and the north does not turn back from.

verses.text:
एष उज्जानको नाम यवक्रीर्यत्र शान्तवान् ।
अरुन्धतीसहायश्च वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः ॥

meaning.en: This is Ujjanaka, where Yavakri found peace, and where the holy seer Vasishtha lived with Arundhati.

verses.text:
ह्रदश्च कुशवानेष यत्र पद्मं कुशेशयम् ।
आश्रमश्चैव रुक्मिण्या यत्राशाम्यदकोपना ॥

meaning.en: This is the lake Kushavan, where the lotus grows among the kusha grass, and the hermitage of Rukmini, where she, free of anger, found peace.

verses.text:
समाधीनां समासस्तु पाण्डवेय श्रुतस्त्वया ।
तं द्रक्ष्यसि महाराज भृगुतुङ्गं महागिरिम् ॥

meaning.en: Pandava, you have heard the summary of the meditative states. You will see that great mountain, Bhrigutunga.

verses.text:
जलां चोपजलां चैव यमुनामभितो नदीम् ।
उशीनरो वै यत्रेष्ट्वा वासवादत्यरिच्यत ॥

meaning.en: On both sides of the Yamuna are the rivers Jala and Upajala, where Ushinara, after sacrificing, rose above Indra.

verses.text:
तां देवसमितिं तस्य वासवश्च विशां पते ।
अभ्यगच्छत राजानं ज्ञातुमग्निश्च भारत ॥

meaning.en: Lord of the people, Indra, and Agni too, came to that king's assembly of the gods to test him, Bharata.

verses.text:
जिज्ञासमानौ वरदौ महात्मानमुशीनरम् ।
इन्द्रः श्येनः कपोतोऽग्निर्भूत्वा यज्ञेऽभिजग्मतुः ॥

meaning.en: Wanting to test the great-souled Ushinara, the two granters of boons, Indra as a hawk and Agni as a dove, came to his sacrifice.

verses.text:
ऊरुं राज्ञः समासाद्य कपोतः श्येनजाद्भयात् ।
शरणार्थी तदा राजन्निलिल्ये भयपीडितः ॥

meaning.en: Coming to the king's thigh, the dove, afraid of the hawk and seeking shelter, hid there, tormented by fear, king.
